claim.statement: POET publicly live-demoed its Blazar and Starlight ELS products at OFC 2026 (Mar 16-19). No primary source confirms these demos used Sivers DFB laser arrays, and no explicit announcement confirms the POET-Sivers ELS 'customer prototype demonstrations in H1 2026' milestone was completed. Demos happened, but Sivers content inside is UNVERIFIED. Note: POET positions Blazar as an order-of-magnitude cheaper substitute for DFB lasers, making partner POET a potential future substitutor of Sivers DFB arrays.
claim.disproof_condition: If POET or Sivers confirm the demoed ELS units contain Sivers laser arrays or announce completed customer prototype demos, upgrade. If the Sivers Q2 2026 report (due Aug 27, 2026) reveals the milestone slipped, downgrade the end-2026 ELS production-readiness claim. If Blazar hybrid lasers displace DFB arrays in POET ELS BOM, downgrade Sivers-POET supply edge.
